sentences.text: Learned Standing Counsel and Sri Ratnesh Chandra, learned counsel for the Awas Evam Vikas Parishad have no objection to the same.

In view thereof, petitioner is permitted to make a fresh detailed representation to respondent no.3- Housing Commissioner, U.P. Awas Evam Vikas Parishad, Lucknow, raising all their grievances,
annexing therewith a copy of this writ petition along with annexures and all the documents in support of their claim within a period of two weeks from today along with a certified copy of this order.

The amount being offered under the Scheme is not binding upon the petitioner and petitioner can always claim compensation as per the provisions of the Act.
